scoring_rationale: Baseline exposure risk for open 'mysql' service

cis_matches.control_title: Keep database engine patched against authentication bypass vulnerabilities
cis_matches.text: Database servers should run supported, patched versions of the database engine. Older MySQL/MariaDB versions have contained authentication bypass vulnerabilities that allow login without correct credentials under certain conditions. Apply vendor security patches promptly and avoid running end-of-life database versions in production.

cis_matches.control_title: Restrict database network exposure to application tiers only
cis_matches.text: Database services should not be reachable from general user networks or the internet. Bind the database to internal interfaces only and use firewall rules or security groups to restrict inbound connections to the specific application servers that require access.

raw_output: VULNERABLE: MySQL DML information disclosure allows local confidentiality breach. IDs: CVE:CVE-2016-0643

cve_records.text: Unspecified vulnerability in Oracle MySQL 5.5.48 and earlier, 5.6.29 and earlier, and 5.7.11 and earlier and MariaDB before 5.5.49, 10.0.x before 10.0.25, and 10.1.x before 10.1.14 allows local users to affect confidentiality via vectors related to DML.
